description: PKITS_NOW = 1_577_836_800 (2020-01-01 UTC) is defined separately in pkix-path/tests/pkits_helper.rs and pkix-chain/tests/e2e.rs. If the PKITS cert validity window changes or a new test epoch is needed, both definitions must be updated in sync. One should reference the other.
title: PKITS_NOW constant duplicated between pkix-path and pkix-chain tests
